title: 2026-11-04 — `rec.py runs --file {name} --show` prints every run's file of that name

data.head: ## 2026-11-04 — `rec.py runs --file {name} --show` prints every run's file of that name

body: `rec.py runs --root . --file 'p5-card-{k}.md' --show` matches by file name across every run, sealed runs included, so a chunk's own phase card comes back beside every earlier phase's card of the same name — at escher's 2026-11-04 wrap, 246 KB of output for one card. A chunk's own card is read in its open phase run dir (`.andromeda/runs/{…}-phase/`), or, once that run is sealed, the call is narrowed to that run by `--kind '{its run name}'` (a glob over a run's name) beside `--file … --show`.

body:
The session added one blitz-tests target, dioxus_runtime_probe (10 tests, both layout modes), that reads what Dioxus 0.7 exposes of component, handlers, written state and readers through public API alone, with no change under packages/ or examples/ and no Cargo.toml change.
It measured the reacts-to-a-click reading as link 2: on Cells the 677 marked no-role elements are 676 cells reacting to click and cells-grid to keydown; on Counter counter-increment carries click and counter-value none; CRUD's crud-list carries keydown; no snapshot field was added (NODE_FIELDS stays thirteen).
It measured that the bridge's listener attributes over-report: a removed listener leaves its attribute and the data-dioxus-id mark standing, a mounted listener writes none, while the vdom walk's dynamic attributes read each element's current listeners exactly.
It re-measured the MountedData hazard at HEAD and pinned it with two should_panic tests: set_focus in a task spawned by a key handler that wrote a signal panics RefCell already borrowed; set_focus called at once in a key handler moves focus and does not panic; the fix is routed to a new chunk, MountedData buffered render, on the founder's word.
The founder answered the probe's three forks: link 2 reads the vdom walk's dynamic attributes, the reacts-to-a-click reading becomes a snapshot field with the UI graph, and hook-local state is read through an escher-side signal registry.
An operator fix moved pulldown-cmark 0.13.5 to 0.13.6 in Cargo.lock (RUSTSEC-2026-0433) and added RUSTSEC-2026-0429 to the deny.toml ignore list, now eight IDs; the zip residual now lives as a store residual row, no .andromeda/residuals.md file stands.

§7 actionable-key rule (fct-77ewqepn) and screen-reader-support sr-actionable-keys: the reacts-to-a-click reading is now measured by link 2 (Cells 676 cells click and cells-grid keydown, Counter counter-increment click and counter-value none, CRUD crud-list keydown); the snapshot field is still not added, and the founder decided it comes as a snapshot field with the UI graph.

screen-reader-support sr-actionable-keys (fct-pfylw46r): the listener mark that DioxusDocument::unkeyed_actionable reads still holds an element whose listener was removed, so the actionable-key check over-includes (conservative), and a mounted listener writes no attribute; read, not run.

keyboard-navigation (fct-gmhtpdel): the MountedData record re-measured at HEAD, its coordinates now DioxusDocument::poll holding inner.borrow_mut() at packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/dioxus_document.rs:295 across vdom.render_immediate at :297, set_focus at packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/events.rs:295 borrowing through doc_mut at events.rs:162, dioxus-core 0.7.10 polling the task through handle_task_wakeup (virtual_dom.rs:611); measured in both layout modes, its fix routed to the chunk MountedData buffered render.

keyboard-navigation (fct-6luzygdm): its synchronous MountedData::scroll_to and NodeHandle claims were re-read and hold unmoved; the synchronous set_focus in a key handler was measured acting with no panic.
a11y-scope-summary (fct-r6zswm2d): its move of pulldown-cmark to 0.13.5 is superseded; pulldown-cmark now resolves 0.13.6 in Cargo.lock, fixing RUSTSEC-2026-0433.

Every a11y-plan claim owned by a .andromeda/residuals.md line (the Dioxus crates adapter fct-kbjv4usk, the tree lifecycle fct-zyrpeqlm, the ARIA states fct-cixbakze, the Cells role and cell semantics in §5 Per-surface keyboard shortcuts, the reacts-to-a-click reading fct-77ewqepn): residuals now live as residual rows in the store and no .andromeda/residuals.md file stands, so the path named is stale.

Any blitz-tests count a11y-plan carries: 158 .rs files directly under tests/blitz-tests/tests/ and 157 test targets (157 and 156 before); run all passed 743, failed 0, ignored 12 (733 before); run stand unmoved at 237 over 51 files.

keyboard-navigation keyboard-shortcuts and screen-reader-support: Cells' cells-grid is now measured as the one Cells element reacting to keydown and the 676 cells to click; CRUD's crud-list measured carrying keydown, its rows carrying no listener reading.

Any a11y-plan statement on Dioxus listener removal or the bridge's listener attributes: remove_event_listener (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/mutation_writer.rs:355-360) is reached only when a listener attribute leaves the element's attribute list, lowering the per-kind count alone; create_event_listener (mutation_writer.rs:331-352) writes the event-named attribute beside the mark.
screen-reader-support sr-snapshot: NODE_FIELDS re-read at thirteen, unmoved; the founder's fork 3 answer schedules the reacts-to-a-click field with the UI graph, not now.

body_fields.fact: The reacts-to-a-click reading, measured by dioxus_runtime_probe link 2 in both layout modes: on Cells the 677 elements carrying the listener mark and no role are 676 cells reacting to click and cells-grid reacting to keydown; on Counter counter-increment carries click and counter-value none; CRUD's crud-list carries keydown; no snapshot field added.

The bridge's listener attributes over-report: a listener removed on a re-render leaves its event attribute and the data-dioxus-id mark while a click no longer acts, and a mounted listener writes none; the vdom walk's dynamic attributes (VNode.dynamic_attrs, VNode::mounted_dynamic_attribute, public dioxus-core 0.7.10 API) read each element's current listeners exactly, mounted included.

The founder's answers to the probe's forks (2026-11-04, inputs#I6): link 2 reads the vdom walk's dynamic attributes, the reacts-to-a-click reading becomes a snapshot field with the UI graph, and links 3 and 4 for hook-local state go through an escher-side signal registry.

dioxus_runtime_probe (tests/blitz-tests/tests/dioxus_runtime_probe.rs, 10 tests, 8 looping both layout modes) pins the MountedData hazard as two should_panic tests, one per mode, their precondition asserted first (the handle held, the key target focused by Tab), and mounted_data_asked_at_once_in_a_key_handler_acts shows a synchronous set_focus moving focus; the port chunk MountedData buffered render inverts the pin; the target runs in the workspace test leg and run all, in neither the a11y leg nor stand-repeat.

Dioxus 0.7.10 public API reads a node's owning component with no fork-level change — VirtualDom::base_scope, ScopeState::try_root_node, VNode.template.roots, VNode.dynamic_nodes, VNode::mounted_root, VComponent::mounted_scope and VComponent.name — a deleted CRUD row resolving to no component.

The vdom walk's dynamic attributes (VNode.dynamic_attrs, VNode::mounted_dynamic_attribute) read an element's current listeners exactly, mounted included, where the bridge's listener attributes (an attribute named the event valued rust func beside the data-dioxus-id mark) keep a removed listener and omit mounted.

dioxus-core 0.7.10 reaches remove_event_listener only when a listener attribute leaves an element's attribute list (a spread); a listener whose value turns to AttributeValue::None under the same name is written through set_attribute as an on{event} attribute, so the bridge's event attribute stays either way (diff/node.rs:416-536).

For a GlobalSignal, Readable::subscribers() visited inside VirtualDom::in_runtime give through ReactiveContext::origin_scope exactly its reader components' scopes, and a writer's click changes exactly the readers' nodes in the snapshot diff; for hook-local use_signal state neither the readers nor the written state are reachable through public API.

The MountedData fix is a port of upstream 286874cc1's buffered render onto the Dioxus 0.7 bridge in a chunk of its own (founder's word): a buffer of its own recording 0.7's WriteMutations calls, replayed into the existing MutationWriter so mutation_writer.rs stays byte-identical to upstream at 434e0661, flush_queued_mounted_events unchanged and its two callers (dioxus_document.rs:167, :300) changing shape — an engine change for every Dioxus document.

The founder's answers for The UI graph: links 3 and 4 for hook-local state through an escher-side signal registry, link 2 read by the vdom walk's dynamic attributes, and the reacts-to-a-click reading becoming a snapshot field with the graph.

The session added one test target, tests/blitz-tests/tests/dioxus_runtime_probe.rs (10 tests, both layout modes), that reads through public Dioxus 0.7.10 API what each node's component, listeners, written state and readers are; no crate, symbol, package, example or Cargo.toml changed.
It measured the MountedData hazard at HEAD: a task spawned from a key handler that wrote a signal and calls set_focus panics RefCell already borrowed (DioxusDocument::poll holds the borrow across render_immediate); the same set_focus called at once in the handler moves focus. The fix is routed to a later port chunk, not made here.
It measured that the bridge's listener attributes beside the data-dioxus-id mark over-report (a removed listener's attribute stays; a mounted listener writes none), while the vdom walk's dynamic attributes read current listeners exactly; no snapshot field was added (NODE_FIELDS thirteen).
An operator fix commit bumped pulldown-cmark 0.13.5 to 0.13.6 in Cargo.lock (RUSTSEC-2026-0433, reached only through rdme) and added RUSTSEC-2026-0429 (zip 2.4.2) to the deny.toml ignore list, now eight IDs.
Counts moved: blitz-tests 158 .rs files and 157 test targets; run all 743 passed, 0 failed, 12 ignored; run stand unmoved at 237 over 51 files. Nothing retired.

Motion's claim that a programmatic into-view scroll (MountedData scroll_to, called synchronously) writes nested scrolling boxes at once: re-read against the MountedData hazard and found unmoved; the panic is measured only for set_focus from a spawned task, and a synchronous MountedData call acts.

Any design-system text naming MountedData focus or scroll calls from Dioxus handlers: the hazard is now measured at packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/dioxus_document.rs:295 and :297, events.rs:295 (set_focus) and events.rs:162 (doc_mut); get_scroll_offset and get_scroll_size borrow shared through doc at events.rs:152, read and not run.

Any run all count carried in a fixture or test line: now 743 passed, 0 failed, 12 ignored (was 733); run stand unmoved at 237 over 51 files.

Text on rdme (the readme app styling GitHub markdown and octicons, apps/readme/assets/github-markdown.css): its markdown parser pulldown-cmark resolves 0.13.6 now (was 0.13.5); no rdme source, asset or option changed, ENABLE_WIKILINKS never set.
Desktop-native surface text on Dioxus apps opening through dioxus_native::launch: Dioxus stays at the 0.7.3 requirement (dioxus-core and dioxus-signals 0.7.10 in the lock); re-read, unmoved.

Any claim about the data-dioxus-id listener mark or a node's listener attributes marking an element as reacting to click: the mark now measured to over-include an element whose listener was removed; on Cells 677 marked elements stating no role are 676 cells reacting to click and cells-grid to keydown; on Counter counter-increment carries click and counter-value none.
Motion's harness lines (VirtualClock, settle, click, type and press leaving the clock): the probe drives Harness from_vdom, press, click, pump and focused unchanged; re-read, unmoved.

The browser capture feature (mobile-native capture, apps/browser): its anyrender_serialize 0.8.0 dependency pulls zip 2.4.2, whose RUSTSEC-2026-0429 is now ignored by ID beside three others; deserialize reads entries by_name and never calls extract; no capture code changed.
Any line citation into Cargo.lock or deny.toml: Cargo.lock lines 6505 and 6507 changed (pulldown-cmark version and checksum); deny.toml gained line 26, the ignore list at deny.toml:20-30.
Color palette, core colors, surface scale, text hierarchy, semantic colors, border progression and the SelectListView engine constants: no colour, token, stylesheet or engine paint code changed.
Typography, font loading, system-fonts for blitz-tests and build_single_font_ctx: no font or text-measuring code changed; the new test target does not change the blitz-tests font feature.
Spacing, depth strategy, hit-testing and paint clipping, and border radius: no layout, paint or hit-test code moved.
Iconography and cursors: browser icons, IconButton, favicons and cursor selection are untouched; no apps/browser file changed.
CLI surface: escher-session and its mcp role, stdout JSON-only and the exit-status classes 0 to 3 are unchanged; VERBS twelve, CAUSES eight and SessionError fifteen unmoved.
Web-spa and mobile-native platform and toolkit lines (canvas surface, IS_MOBILE, Android and iOS builds, publish workflow): no workflow, CI step or platform code changed.

The NO RECORDED INTENT and NOT YET MEASURED markers (brand identity, anti-patterns, self-validation, design decisions log, project-wide scales, reduced motion absent): the session records no design intent and measures no token scale.

body:
The chunk 2026-11-04-dioxus-runtime-probe added one blitz-tests test target, dioxus_runtime_probe (607 lines, 10 tests, both layout modes), which reads the public Dioxus 0.7.10 API to measure what is exposed of component, handlers, written state and readers; nothing under packages/ or examples/ and no Cargo.toml changed.
The probe pins the MountedData hazard at HEAD as two should_panic tests (set_focus from a task a key handler spawned panics RefCell already borrowed through doc_mut while DioxusDocument::poll holds the document borrow); the fix is routed to a separate port chunk, no engine change made.
It measured the listener reading: the bridge's listener attributes over-report (a removed listener's attribute and mark stay), while the vdom walk's dynamic attributes read current listeners exactly; the reacts-to-a-click reading measured, no snapshot field added, NODE_FIELDS thirteen.
An operator fix commit bumped pulldown-cmark 0.13.5 to 0.13.6 in Cargo.lock alone (RUSTSEC-2026-0433) and added RUSTSEC-2026-0429 (zip 2.4.2) to the deny.toml advisories ignore list, now eight IDs; the zip residual res-h7acz56c revised in the store.
The obs gate: the silence census over the new file reads 0 (no print, env read, escher_telemetry, tracing_subscriber or listener bind), and no failure message or evidence document carries a read value; no log site, span, field, log field, sink or env read added anywhere.
Counts moved: blitz-tests 158 .rs files and 157 test targets; run all passed 743, failed 0, ignored 12; run stand unmoved at 237 over 51 files; CI green 17/17 on 9b3b29714.

The section 3 Logging stack and log-coverage silence rows for test checks (absence logs group): a new blitz-tests target, dioxus_runtime_probe, now stands that installs no subscriber, reads no env var, prints nothing and binds no listener, the silence census reading 0 over it; the standing rows are earlier chunks' own and stay true, the new row is new text.
Any count of blitz-tests test files or targets: now 158 .rs files directly under tests/blitz-tests/tests/ and 157 test targets (157 and 156 before), dioxus_runtime_probe the latest.
Any count of the agent-run run all result: passed 743, failed 0, ignored 12 (733, 0, 12 before); run stand unmoved at 237 over 51 files because the new file carries no stand_ prefix.

Statements of which stand_* or engine checks are silent, or of the silence probe pattern (println!, eprintln!, print!, dbg!, std::env, env::var, escher_telemetry, tracing_subscriber, UnixListener, TcpListener, bind): the same pattern fired over dioxus_runtime_probe.rs as its gate 2, exit 1 and last line 0.

The MountedData hazard as a panic class in dioxus-native-dom: a task spawned from a key handler that calls set_focus (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/events.rs:295, through doc_mut at events.rs:162) panics RefCell already borrowed while DioxusDocument::poll holds inner.borrow_mut() (dioxus_document.rs:295) across render_immediate (:297); any error-capture or panic-hook text that names which panics the engine or a binary raises, re-measured, not fixed; the synchronous set_focus call does not panic.

Statements over dioxus-native-dom's listener mark and listener attributes (create_event_listener, mutation_writer.rs:331-352; remove_event_listener, mutation_writer.rs:355-360): the attribute and the data-dioxus-id mark stay after a listener is removed, a mounted listener writes none; any reading that treats the mark as exact over-includes.

Text naming pulldown-cmark's resolved version or the dependency audit: pulldown-cmark resolves 0.13.6 (0.13.5 before), RUSTSEC-2026-0433 fixed; reached only through rdme, whose tracing feature wiring is unchanged.

Text naming the deny.toml advisories ignore list or the zip 2.4.2 ignores: the zip IDs are now four (RUSTSEC-2026-0367, 0368, 0369, 0429), the list eight IDs at deny.toml:20-30; zip reaches the graph only through anyrender_serialize 0.8.0 under apps/browser's capture feature.

Section 9 CI Integration, the Dependency audit leg: a CI audit can go red on advisories published after a green base with Cargo.lock and deny.toml unchanged (CI#41911351081), and the local fast leg runs no audit, bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh audit being the local reproduction; final CI#41914044942 green 17/17; no CI step, artifact or leg list moved.
Any line citation into Cargo.lock or deny.toml: Cargo.lock lines 6505 and 6507 changed (pulldown-cmark version and checksum), deny.toml line 26 added, shifting later deny.toml lines by one.

Statements that a test target is reached by the workspace test leg and run all but not by run stand, stand-repeat or the a11y leg: dioxus_runtime_probe is auto-discovered, no manifest line, reached by the workspace test leg, run all and run dioxus_runtime_probe.

Statements over what the snapshot or driver exposes of components, handlers and state readers: the probe reads, in process and into assertions only, component names (VComponent.name), current listeners (VNode.dynamic_attrs) and a GlobalSignal's subscribers (Subscribers::visit, origin_scope); hook-local use_signal state is not exposed without a fork-level change; no snapshot field, driver verb or span field added.

body:
The session added one blitz-tests test target, dioxus_runtime_probe (10 tests, both layout modes), which reads public Dioxus 0.7.10 API only to measure what Dioxus exposes of component, handlers, written state and readers; no crate, symbol, manifest or file under packages or examples changed.
It re-measured the MountedData hazard at HEAD and pinned it with two should_panic tests: a task a key handler spawned is first polled inside DioxusDocument::poll's held borrow, and its set_focus panics RefCell already borrowed; the fix is routed to a chunk of its own (port of upstream 286874cc1's buffered render) on the founder's word.
An operator fix commit bumped pulldown-cmark 0.13.5 to 0.13.6 in Cargo.lock alone (fixing RUSTSEC-2026-0433) and added RUSTSEC-2026-0429 (zip 2.4.2) to the deny.toml advisories ignore, now eight IDs, the zip IDs four; the zip drop residual res-h7acz56c was revised to rev 2.
The audit leg reads advisories ok, licenses ok locally and in CI#41914044942, green 17/17; run all moved to 743 passed, 0 failed, 12 ignored, and blitz-tests to 158 .rs files and 157 test targets.

Dependency Security, the zip and pulldown-cmark ignore and resolution text (dependency-security fct-a4qh6ioi): the zip 2.4.2 ignores go from three IDs to four (RUSTSEC-2026-0367, 0368, 0369 and now 0429), and RUSTSEC-2026-0414's pulldown-cmark 0.13.5 resolution becomes 0.13.6, which also fixes RUSTSEC-2026-0433.
Dependency Security, the Audit tool: the deny.toml advisories ignore list now holds eight IDs, cited at deny.toml:20-30, the new line at 26; any count of ignores or deny.toml line citation moves.

Dependency Security, the zip ignores' written reason: re-read for RUSTSEC-2026-0429. zip 2.4.2 reaches the graph only through anyrender_serialize 0.8.0 (the browser capture feature), whose deserialize opens a ZipArchive and reads entries by_name (anyrender_serialize-0.8.0/src/lib.rs:562-614) and never calls extract. No fixed release is reachable, since anyrender_serialize 0.8.0 is the latest and requires zip ^2.1.

Dependency Security, pulldown-cmark: the update was a lock-only, semver-compatible cargo update --precise 0.13.6 with no coupled pin, reached only through rdme. RUSTSEC-2026-0433 is quadratic parsing under ENABLE_WIKILINKS, an option rdme never sets, so no path the repo uses was affected. Any pulldown-cmark version or advisory text moves.

Dependency Security, the zip drop residual: res-h7acz56c is revised rev 1 to rev 2 and names the fourth ID, its status re-carried and disposition 0.3.0 unchanged. The residuals now live as residual rows in the store, and no .andromeda/residuals.md stands, so any text pointing to a residuals.md line for it is stale.

Dependency Security, CI integration and update policy: the CI Dependency audit went red on CI#41911351081 for two advisories published after the base's green audit, with Cargo.lock and deny.toml unchanged. After the fix it went green on CI#41914044942. Text claiming the audit state holds between lock changes is affected.

Dependency Security, the upstream 286874cc1 left-out note (dependency-security fct-f5jtvf4a): still true, but its buffered render is now routed to a port chunk of its own onto the 0.7 bridge. That port writes its own buffer of 0.7 WriteMutations calls and replays it into the existing MutationWriter, which keeps mutation_writer.rs byte-identical to upstream at 434e0661.

Error Handling, the MountedData record (error-handling fct-7ni72vcj): re-measured at HEAD. inner.borrow_mut() is held at packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/dioxus_document.rs:295 across vdom.render_immediate at :297. dioxus-core 0.7.10 polls the queued task through handle_task_wakeup (virtual_dom.rs:611). set_focus is at packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/events.rs:295 and borrows through doc_mut at events.rs:162. The coordinates and the routing to the port chunk move.

Error Handling, the MountedData contrast: set_focus called at once in a key handler, with no task, moves focus and does not panic (measured in both modes). get_scroll_offset and get_scroll_size take a shared borrow through doc at events.rs:152, read from the code and not run. The windowed path was read, not run.

Error Handling, Panic paths (the Dioxus nodes entry) and Graceful degradation (the try_doc entry, events.rs:155-177): a measured panic path, RefCell already borrowed through doc_mut in a task polled during render, now stands beside them, and its coordinates fall inside those citations.

Error Handling, the test inventory of panic guards: two should_panic pins (mounted_data_in_a_task_a_key_handler_spawned_panics_non_incremental and _incremental) and the contrast test mounted_data_asked_at_once_in_a_key_handler_acts join the tests that bear on panics. Each pin asserts its precondition first: the handle is held and the key target is focused by Tab.

Any count security-plan carries of blitz-tests files or targets, or of run all totals: blitz-tests now has 158 .rs files and 157 test targets (was 157 and 156), and run all is 743 passed, 0 failed, 12 ignored (was 733). The new target is not in run stand (237 tests over 51 files, unchanged), stand-repeat or the a11y leg.
Dependency Security, Dioxus versions: Dioxus stays at the 0.7.3 requirement, with dioxus-core, dioxus-signals and dioxus-html 0.7.10 in the lock. A version claim is re-confirmed, not moved.

body_fields.fact: A CI Dependency audit can go red on advisories published after the base's green audit even with Cargo.lock and deny.toml unchanged; the local fast leg runs no audit, and bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh audit is the local reproduction to run before a push.

RUSTSEC-2026-0429 (zip 2.4.2: ZipArchive::extract aborts the process on a symlink entry with a large declared size, fixed only in zip 9.0) is ignored by ID with the zip IDs' reason, because anyrender_serialize 0.8.0 never calls extract.

The MountedData RefCell hazard is pinned at HEAD by dioxus_runtime_probe's two should_panic tests, one per layout mode, with no fix applied; the port chunk MountedData buffered render, the founder's answer Port as a separate chunk, inverts the pin, with upstream's test task_polled_during_render_can_access_document as its witness.

body_fields.fact: tests/blitz-tests/tests/dioxus_runtime_probe.rs (10 tests, 8 looping for incremental in [false, true], two should_panic hazard pins, one per mode) reads Dioxus 0.7.10 public API only to measure link 1 (the component that rendered each node, a deleted CRUD row resolving to nothing), link 2 (each node's handlers), link 3 (a handler's effect as its step's snapshot diff) and link 4 (a held signal's readers), with no fork-level change.

The MountedData hazard is pinned by mounted_data_in_a_task_a_key_handler_spawned_panics_non_incremental and _incremental (should_panic), their precondition asserted first by hazard_ready (the handle held, the key target focused by Tab), beside mounted_data_asked_at_once_in_a_key_handler_acts (synchronous set_focus moves focus, no panic); get_scroll_offset and get_scroll_size (shared borrow through doc, events.rs:152) and the windowed path are read, not run.

The bridge's listener attributes (an attribute named the event, valued <rust func>, written by create_event_listener, mutation_writer.rs:331-352) over-report: a listener removed on a re-render (reached only when it leaves the attribute list, a spread) leaves its attribute and the data-dioxus-id mark while a click no longer acts, and a mounted listener writes none; VNode.dynamic_attrs with VNode::mounted_dynamic_attribute read current listeners exactly — pinned by link_2_a_removed_listeners_attribute_stays.

For a GlobalSignal, subscribers() visited in VirtualDom::in_runtime give through origin_scope() exactly its two reader components' scopes and the writer's click changes exactly the readers' nodes in the snapshot diff (links_3_and_4_a_held_signals_subscribers_are_its_readers); for hook-local use_signal state links 3 and 4 are not exposed without a fork-level change (Scope.hooks pub(crate)) — read, not run.

dioxus_runtime_probe keeps its one-reader pages in its own file: toggled_listener (a Vec<Attribute> spread in and out), shared_state (Writer, FirstReader, SecondReader over a GlobalSignal) and hazard (hazard_spawned, hazard_synchronous).

The planned port of upstream 286874cc1's buffered render onto the 0.7 bridge writes its own buffer recording 0.7's WriteMutations calls and replays them into the existing MutationWriter, keeping mutation_writer.rs byte-identical to upstream at 434e0661, flush_queued_mounted_events unchanged and its two callers (dioxus_document.rs:167, :300) changing shape — read, not run.
